description: Visual natural-language evaluation cases for the default image context module. Instructions are grounded in real UE/AirSim RGB fixtures and avoid fixed-distance or fixed-angle movement commands.

cases.instruction: Describe whether the current image contains a possible entrance candidate near the glass curtain-wall building base. Only report visible visual facts.

phase.name: search_visual_entrance
phase.goal: identify building entrance, doorway, entrance sign, or building-base opening candidates

cases.instruction: Identify yellow vehicles and large trees that could be used as visual references, and describe their relative positions in the image.

phase.name: identify_visual_landmarks
done_when: at least one stable landmark and its image position are described

cases.instruction: Judge whether the foreground paved area appears open, and point out nearby vehicles or trees that affect visual understanding.

phase.name: check_visible_free_space
phase.goal: describe visible open paved area and nearby visual context
done_when: foreground or midground open-area visibility is described

cases.instruction: Confirm whether a clear entrance sign is visible. If not, describe only relevant building-base or vehicle visual references.

phase.name: verify_entrance_visibility
phase.goal: judge whether an entrance sign is clearly visible
done_when: entrance-sign visibility and related visual references are described

cases.instruction: The current phase target is a building entrance. Distinguish vehicles from entrance candidates, and do not treat yellow or white-purple vehicles as the entrance target.

phase.name: separate_target_from_landmarks
phase.goal: distinguish entrance target candidates from vehicle visual references
done_when: vehicles are described as references or non-targets unless a clear entrance candidate exists

cases.instruction: Describe the image-position relationship among the right-side white vehicle, red vehicle, and building base, for judging whether entrance candidates are occluded by vehicles.

phase.name: relate_vehicle_to_building_base
phase.goal: describe vehicle positions relative to building-base candidate areas
done_when: vehicle and building-base relative positions are described
